# Preparation failures are atomic: the target never starts.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin

cp raw-fixture raw.txt
cp malformed-fixture malformed.env
exec runprobe write-size oversize.txt 65537
exec sesam add raw.txt malformed.env oversize.txt
rm raw.txt malformed.env oversize.txt

! exec sesam run --env-file malformed.env -- runprobe mark started-malformed
stderr 'invalid byte in unquoted value'
! exists started-malformed
! exists malformed.env

! exec sesam run --secret oversize.txt -- runprobe mark started-oversize
stderr 'exceeds 65536 bytes'
! exists started-oversize
! exists oversize.txt

! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt -- command-that-does-not-exist
stderr 'find command.*using inherited PATH'

exec chmod +x bad-exec
! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt -- ./bad-exec
stderr 'exec command.*exec format error'
exec sesam id
stdout '^admin$'

exec runprobe status sesam run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe exit 23
stdout 'exit=23 signal=0'

exec runprobe status sesam run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe signal
stdout 'exit=-1 signal=15'

! exec sesam run -- runprobe mark started-no-selector
stderr 'at least one --secret, --env-file, or --all is required'
! exists started-no-selector

! exec sesam run --all --secret raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-conflicting-selection
stderr '--all and --secret cannot be used together'
! exists started-conflicting-selection

! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt --
stderr 'a command is required after --'

! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt runprobe mark started-no-separator
stderr 'a command is required after --'
! exists started-no-separator

# Inherited names are never overwritten.
env SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT=parent
! exec sesam run --secret raw.txt -- runprobe mark started-collision
stderr 'SESAM_SECRET_RAW_TXT.*collides with inherited environment'
! exists started-collision

-- raw-fixture --
raw
-- malformed-fixture --
GOOD=value
BAD=two words
-- bad-exec --
not an executable format
